local bls, brs = bit.lshift, bit.rshift
local mod = 1000003
local function badd(x, y) return (x + y) % mod end
local function bmul(x, y) return (x * y) % mod end

local function modpow(src, pow)
  local res = 1
  while 0 < pow do
    if pow % 2 == 1 then
      res = bmul(res, src)
      pow = pow - 1
    end
    src = bmul(src, src)
    pow = brs(pow, 1)
  end
  return res
end

local function modinv(src)
  return modpow(src, mod - 2)
end

local fact = {1}
for i = 2, mod - 1 do
  fact[i] = bmul(fact[i - 1], i)
end

local q = io.read("*n")
for iq = 1, q do
  local x, d, n = io.read("*n", "*n", "*n")
  if d == 0 then
    print(modpow(x, n))
  else
    local a = bmul(x, modinv(d))
    local lim = a + n - 1
    if mod <= lim then
      print(0)
    else
      local numer = fact[lim]
      numer = bmul(numer, modpow(d, n))
      local denom = 1
      if 1 < a then
        denom = fact[a - 1]
      end
      local ret = bmul(numer, modinv(denom))
      print(ret)
    end
  end
end

query# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int# -> Int#
query# x# d# n#
  | isTrue# (x# ==# 0#) = 0#
  | isTrue# (d# ==# 0#) = x# `powRem#` n#

  | isTrue# (end# >=# MOD#) = 0#
  | otherwise = (unI# $ factorial VU.! (I# end#))
                `mult#` (unI# $ invFact VU.! (I# begm1#))

powRem# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int#

  where
    go acc# val# 0# = acc#
    go acc# val# expt#
      = go (if isTrue# (andI# expt# 1#) then acc# `mult#` val# else acc#)
           (val# `mult#` val#)
           (expt# `uncheckedIShiftRL#` 1#)

solve :: Int -> U.Vector (Int, Int, Int) -> U.Vector Int

solve' :: (Int, Int, Int) -> Int
solve' (x, d, n)
    | d == 0 = x ^% n
    | n >= modulus = 0
    | xd + n - 1 >= modulus = 0
    | otherwise = (d ^% n) *% (fact (xd + n - 1) *% recipFact (xd - 1))
  where
    !xd = x /% d

modulus :: Int

infixr 8 ^%

type IntMod = Int

intMod :: Int -> IntMod
intMod x = rem x MOD

intModValidate :: Int -> Bool
intModValidate x = 0 <= x && x < MOD

(+%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) +% (I# y#) = case x# +# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# -# ((r# >=# MOD#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (+%) #-}

(-%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) -% (I# y#) = case x# -# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# +# ((r# <# 0#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (-%) #-}

(*%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) *% (I# y#) = I# ((x# *# y#) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (*%) #-}

(/%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) /% (I# y#) = go# y# MOD# 1# 0#
  where
    go# a# b# u# v#
        | isTrue# (b# ># 0#) = case a# `quotInt#` b# of
            q# -> go# b# (a# -# (q# *# b#)) v# (u# -# (q# *# v#))
        | otherwise = I# ((x# *# (u# +# MOD#)) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (/%) #-}

(^%) :: IntMod -> Int -> IntMod
x ^% n
    | n > 0 = go 1 x n
    | n == 0 = 1
    | otherwise = go 1 (1 /% x) (-n)
  where
    go !acc !y !m
        | m .&. 1 == 0 = go acc (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR m 1)
        | m == 1 = acc *% y
        | otherwise = go (acc *% y) (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR (m - 1) 1)

fact :: Int -> IntMod
fact = U.unsafeIndex factCache
{-# INLINE fact #-}

recipFact :: Int -> IntMod
recipFact = U.unsafeIndex recipFactCache
{-# INLINE recipFact #-}

comb :: Int -> Int -> IntMod
comb n k = fact n *% recipFact (n - k) *% recipFact k
{-# INLINE comb #-}

factCacheSize :: Int
factCacheSize = min (modulus - 1) 2000200
{-# INLINE factCacheSize #-}

factCache :: U.Vector IntMod
factCache = U.scanl' (*%) 1 $ U.generate factCacheSize (+1)
{-# NOINLINE factCache #-}

recipFactCache :: U.Vector IntMod
recipFactCache = U.scanr' (*%) (1 /% (factCache U.! factCacheSize))
    $ U.generate factCacheSize (+1)
{-# NOINLINE recipFactCache #-}

solve' :: (Int, Int, Int) -> Int
solve' (x, d, n)
    | n >= modulus = 0
    | d == 0 = x ^% n
    | otherwise = (d ^% n) *% (fact (xd + n - 1) /% fact (xd - 1))
  where

#define MOD 1000003

modulus :: Int
modulus = MOD

infixr 8 ^%
infixl 7 *%, /%
infixl 6 +%, -%

type IntMod = Int

intMod :: Int -> IntMod
intMod x = rem x MOD

intModValidate :: Int -> Bool
intModValidate x = 0 <= x && x < MOD

(+%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) +% (I# y#) = case x# +# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# -# ((r# >=# MOD#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (+%) #-}

(-%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) -% (I# y#) = case x# -# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# +# ((r# <# 0#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (-%) #-}

(*%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) *% (I# y#) = I# ((x# *# y#) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (*%) #-}

(/%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) /% (I# y#) = go# y# MOD# 1# 0#
  where
    go# a# b# u# v#
        | isTrue# (b# ># 0#) = case a# `quotInt#` b# of
            q# -> go# b# (a# -# (q# *# b#)) v# (u# -# (q# *# v#))
        | otherwise = I# ((x# *# (u# +# MOD#)) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (/%) #-}

(^%) :: IntMod -> Int -> IntMod
x ^% n
    | n > 0 = go 1 x n
    | n == 0 = 1
    | otherwise = go 1 (1 /% x) (-n)
  where
    go !acc !y !m
        | m .&. 1 == 0 = go acc (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR m 1)
        | m == 1 = acc *% y
        | otherwise = go (acc *% y) (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR (m - 1) 1)

fact :: Int -> IntMod
fact = U.unsafeIndex factCache
{-# INLINE fact #-}

recipFact :: Int -> IntMod
recipFact = U.unsafeIndex recipFactCache
{-# INLINE recipFact #-}

comb :: Int -> Int -> IntMod
comb n k = fact n *% recipFact (n - k) *% recipFact k
{-# INLINE comb #-}

factCacheSize :: Int
factCacheSize = 2000200
{-# INLINE factCacheSize #-}

factCache :: U.Vector IntMod
factCache = U.scanl' (*%) 1 $ U.generate factCacheSize (+1)
{-# NOINLINE factCache #-}

recipFactCache :: U.Vector IntMod
recipFactCache = U.scanr' (*%) (1 /% (factCache U.! factCacheSize))
    $ U.generate factCacheSize (+1)
{-# NOINLINE recipFactCache #-}

exEuclid :: (Eq a, Integral a) => a -> a -> (a, a, a)
exEuclid !f !g = loop 1 0 0 1 f g
  where loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f 0 = (f, u0, v0)
        loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f g =
          case divMod f g of
            (q,r) -> loop u1 (u0 - q * u1) v1 (v0 - q * v1) g r

modulo = 10^6+3 :: Int64
addMod, subMod, mulMod, divM :: Int64 -> Int64 -> Int64
addMod !x !y = (x + y) `rem` modulo
subMod !x !y = (x - y) `mod` modulo
mulMod !x !y = (x * y) `rem` modulo
recipM :: Int64 -> Int64
recipM !x = case exEuclid x modulo of
             (1,a,_) -> a `mod` modulo
             (-1,a,_) -> (-a) `mod` modulo
divM !x !y = x `mulMod` recipM y

newtype N = N { unwrapN :: Int64 } deriving (Eq)
instance Show N where
  show (N x) = show x
instance Num N where
  N x + N y = N ((x + y) `rem` modulo)
  N x - N y = N ((x - y) `mod` modulo)
  N x * N y = N ((x * y) `rem` modulo)
  fromInteger n = N (fromInteger (n `mod` fromIntegral modulo))
  abs = undefined; signum = undefined

instance Fractional N where
  N x / N y = N (divM x y)
  recip (N x) = N (recipM x)
  fromRational = undefined

factV :: U.Vector N
factV = U.scanl' (*) 1 (U.enumFromN 1 (fromIntegral (modulo - 1)))

factM :: Int64 -> N
factM n | n < modulo = factV U.! fromIntegral n
        | otherwise = 0

invFactM :: Int64 -> N
invFactM n | n < modulo = if even n
                          then - factV U.! fromIntegral (modulo - n - 1)
                          else factV U.! fromIntegral (modulo - n - 1)
           | otherwise = error "invFactM: divide by zero"

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> N
solve x 0 n = (fromIntegral x)^n
solve !x !d !n = let !x' = fromIntegral x :: N
                     !d' = fromIntegral d :: N
                     !xd = unwrapN (x' / d')
                 in if xd + fromIntegral n - 1 >= modulo
                    then 0
                    else d'^n * factM (xd + fromIntegral n - 1) * invFactM (xd - 1)

main = do
  q <- readLn
  replicateM_ q $ do
    Just (x, s) <- BS.readInt <$> BS.getLine
    let Just (d, s') = BS.readInt s
        Just (n, _) = BS.readInt s'
    -- [x,d,n] <- unfoldr (BS.readInt . BS.dropWhile isSpace) <$> BS.getLine
    print (solve x d n)

             (1,a,_) -> a `mod` modulo
             (-1,a,_) -> (-a) `mod` modulo
divM !x !y = x `mulMod` recipM y

newtype N = N { unwrapN :: Int32 } deriving (Eq)
instance Show N where
  show (N x) = show x
instance Num N where
  N x + N y = N ((x + y) `rem` modulo)
  N x - N y = N ((x - y) `mod` modulo)
  N x * N y = N (mulMod x y)
  fromInteger n = N (fromInteger (n `mod` fromIntegral modulo))
  abs = undefined; signum = undefined

instance Fractional N where
  N x / N y = N (divM x y)
  recip (N x) = N (recipM x)
  fromRational = undefined

factV :: U.Vector N
factV = U.scanl' (*) 1 (U.enumFromN 1 (modulo' - 1))

factM :: Int -> N
factM n | n < modulo' = factV U.! n
        | otherwise = 0

invFactM :: Int -> N
invFactM n | n < modulo' = if even n
                           then - factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
                           else factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
           | otherwise = error "invFactM: divide by zero"

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> N
solve x 0 n = (fromIntegral x)^n
solve !x !d !n = let !x' = fromIntegral x :: N
                     !d' = fromIntegral d :: N
                     !xd = fromIntegral $ unwrapN (x' / d') :: Int
                 in if xd + n - 1 >= modulo'
                    then 0
                    else d'^n * factM (xd + fromIntegral n - 1) * invFactM (xd - 1)

readInt3 :: BS.ByteString -> (Int, Int, Int)
readInt3 s =
    let Just (x, s') = BS.readInt s
        Just (d, s'') = BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s'
        Just (n, _) = BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s''
    in (x, d, n)

readInt3' :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe ((Int, Int, Int), BS.ByteString)
readInt3' s = do
    (x, s') <- BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s
    (d, s'') <- BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s'
    (n, rest) <- BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s''
    return ((x, d, n), rest)

type IntMod = Int

intMod :: Int -> IntMod
intMod x = rem x MOD

intModValidate :: Int -> Bool
intModValidate x = 0 <= x && x < MOD

(+%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) +% (I# y#) = case x# +# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# -# ((r# >=# MOD#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (+%) #-}

(-%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) -% (I# y#) = case x# -# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# +# ((r# <# 0#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (-%) #-}

(*%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) *% (I# y#) = I# ((x# *# y#) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (*%) #-}

(/%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) /% (I# y#) = go# y# MOD# 1# 0#
  where
    go# a# b# u# v#
        | isTrue# (b# ># 0#) = case a# `quotInt#` b# of
            q# -> go# b# (a# -# (q# *# b#)) v# (u# -# (q# *# v#))
        | otherwise = I# ((x# *# (u# +# MOD#)) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (/%) #-}

(^%) :: IntMod -> Int -> IntMod
x ^% n
    | n > 0 = go 1 x n
    | n == 0 = 1
    | otherwise = go 1 (1 /% x) (-n)
  where
    go !acc !y !m
        | m .&. 1 == 0 = go acc (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR m 1)
        | m == 1 = acc *% y
        | otherwise = go (acc *% y) (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR (m - 1) 1)

  where loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f 0 = (f, u0, v0)
        loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f g =
          case quotRem f g of
            (q,r) -> loop u1 (u0 - q * u1) v1 (v0 - q * v1) g r

infixr 8 ^%

type IntMod = Int

intMod :: Int -> IntMod
intMod x = rem x MOD

intModValidate :: Int -> Bool
intModValidate x = 0 <= x && x < MOD

(+%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) +% (I# y#) = case x# +# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# -# ((r# >=# MOD#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (+%) #-}

(-%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) -% (I# y#) = case x# -# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# +# ((r# <# 0#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (-%) #-}

(*%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) *% (I# y#) = I# ((x# *# y#) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (*%) #-}

(/%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) /% (I# y#) = go# y# MOD# 1# 0#
  where
    go# a# b# u# v#
        | isTrue# (b# ># 0#) = case a# `quotInt#` b# of
            q# -> go# b# (a# -# (q# *# b#)) v# (u# -# (q# *# v#))
        | otherwise = I# ((x# *# (u# +# MOD#)) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (/%) #-}

(^%) :: IntMod -> Int -> IntMod
x ^% n
    | n > 0 = go 1 x n
    | n == 0 = 1
    | otherwise = go 1 (1 /% x) (-n)
  where
    go !acc !y !m
        | m .&. 1 == 0 = go acc (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR m 1)
        | m == 1 = acc *% y
        | otherwise = go (acc *% y) (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR (m - 1) 1)

recipFact :: Int -> IntMod
recipFact = U.unsafeIndex recipFactCache
{-# INLINE recipFact #-}

comb :: Int -> Int -> IntMod
comb n k = fact n *% recipFact (n - k) *% recipFact k
{-# INLINE comb #-}

factCacheSize :: Int

factCache :: U.Vector IntMod
factCache = U.scanl' (*%) 1 $ U.generate factCacheSize (+1)

exEuclid :: (Eq a, Integral a) => a -> a -> (a, a, a)
exEuclid !f !g = loop 1 0 0 1 f g
  where loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f 0 = (f, u0, v0)
        loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f g =
          case divMod f g of
            (q,r) -> loop u1 (u0 - q * u1) v1 (v0 - q * v1) g r

modulo = 10^6+3 :: Int64
addMod, subMod, mulMod, divM :: Int64 -> Int64 -> Int64
addMod !x !y = (x + y) `rem` modulo
subMod !x !y = (x - y) `mod` modulo
mulMod !x !y = (x * y) `rem` modulo
recipM :: Int64 -> Int64
recipM !x = case exEuclid x modulo of
             (1,a,_) -> a `mod` modulo
             (-1,a,_) -> (-a) `mod` modulo
divM !x !y = x `mulMod` recipM y

newtype N = N { unwrapN :: Int64 } deriving (Eq)
instance Show N where
  show (N x) = show x
instance Num N where
  N x + N y = N ((x + y) `rem` modulo)
  N x - N y = N ((x - y) `mod` modulo)
  N x * N y = N ((x * y) `rem` modulo)
  fromInteger n = N (fromInteger (n `mod` fromIntegral modulo))
  abs = undefined; signum = undefined

instance Fractional N where
  N x / N y = N (divM x y)
  recip (N x) = N (recipM x)
  fromRational = undefined

factL :: [N]
factL = 1 : zipWith (*) factL (map fromInteger [1..])

factFromN :: Int -> Int -> N -> V.Vector N
factFromN n m factN = V.scanl' (\a b -> a * fromIntegral b) factN (V.enumFromN (n+1) (m-1))

factV :: V.Vector N
factV = factFromN 0 200000 1
  <> factFromN 200000 (500000 - 200000) 177247
  <> factFromN 500000 (700000 - 500000) 2
  <> factFromN 700000 (total - 700000) 426941
  where
    total = fromIntegral modulo :: Int

-- factM n == factL !! n == product (map fromInteger [1..n])
-- factM 150000 == 835006
-- factM 300000 == 142803
-- factM 600000 == 715492
-- factM 800000 == 598805
factM :: Int64 -> N
factM n | n < modulo = factV V.! fromIntegral n
        | otherwise = 0

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> N
solve x 0 n = (fromIntegral x)^n
solve !x !d !n = let !x' = fromIntegral x :: N
                     !d' = fromIntegral d :: N
                     !xd = unwrapN (x' / d')
                 in if xd + fromIntegral n - 1 >= modulo
                    then 0
                    else d'^n * factM (xd + fromIntegral n - 1) / factM (xd - 1)

extEuc x0 y0
  = loop (signum x0) 0 (abs x0) 0 (signum y0) (abs y0)
  where
    loop !a !b !x !c !d 0 = (a,b,x)
    loop !a !b !x !c !d !y

    r' = r `mod` m

intModValidate x = 0 <= x && x < MOD

(+%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) +% (I# y#) = case x# +# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# -# ((r# >=# MOD#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (+%) #-}

(-%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) -% (I# y#) = case x# -# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# +# ((r# <# 0#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (-%) #-}

(*%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) *% (I# y#) = I# ((x# *# y#) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (*%) #-}

(/%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) /% (I# y#) = go# y# MOD# 1# 0#
  where
    go# a# b# u# v#
        | isTrue# (b# ># 0#) = case a# `quotInt#` b# of
            q# -> go# b# (a# -# (q# *# b#)) v# (u# -# (q# *# v#))
        | otherwise = I# ((x# *# (u# +# MOD#)) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (/%) #-}

(^%) :: IntMod -> Int -> IntMod
x ^% n
    | n > 0 = go 1 x n
    | n == 0 = 1
    | otherwise = go 1 (1 /% x) (-n)
  where
    go !acc !y !m
        | m .&. 1 == 0 = go acc (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR m 1)
        | m == 1 = acc *% y
        | otherwise = go (acc *% y) (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR (m - 1) 1)

fact :: Int -> IntMod
fact = U.unsafeIndex factCache
{-# INLINE fact #-}

recipFact :: Int -> IntMod
recipFact = U.unsafeIndex recipFactCache
{-# INLINE recipFact #-}

comb :: Int -> Int -> IntMod
comb n k = fact n *% recipFact (n - k) *% recipFact k
{-# INLINE comb #-}

factCacheSize :: Int
factCacheSize = 2000200
{-# INLINE factCacheSize #-}

factCache :: U.Vector IntMod
factCache = U.scanl' (*%) 1 $ U.generate factCacheSize (+1)
{-# NOINLINE factCache #-}

recipFactCache :: U.Vector IntMod
recipFactCache = U.scanr' (*%) (1 /% (factCache U.! factCacheSize))
    $ U.generate factCacheSize (+1)
{-# NOINLINE recipFactCache #-}

exEuclid :: (Eq a, Integral a) => a -> a -> (a, a, a)
exEuclid !f !g = loop 1 0 0 1 f g
  where loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f 0 = (f, u0, v0)
        loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f g =
          case quotRem f g of
            (q,0) -> (g, u1, v1)
            (q,r) -> loop u1 (u0 - q * u1) v1 (v0 - q * v1) g r

modulo = 10^6+3 :: Int32
modulo' = fromIntegral modulo :: Int
addMod, subMod, mulMod, divM :: Int32 -> Int32 -> Int32
addMod !x !y = (x + y) `rem` modulo
subMod !x !y = (x - y) `mod` modulo
mulMod !x !y = fromIntegral ((fromIntegral x * fromIntegral y :: Int64) `rem` fromIntegral modulo)
recipM :: Int32 -> Int32
recipM !x = case exEuclid x modulo of
             (1,a,_) -> a `mod` modulo
             (-1,a,_) -> (-a) `mod` modulo
divM !x !y = x `mulMod` recipM y

newtype N = N { unwrapN :: Int32 } deriving (Eq)
instance Show N where
  show (N x) = show x
instance Num N where
  N x + N y = N ((x + y) `rem` modulo)
  N x - N y = N ((x - y) `mod` modulo)
  N x * N y = N (mulMod x y)
  fromInteger n = N (fromInteger (n `mod` fromIntegral modulo))
  abs = undefined; signum = undefined

instance Fractional N where
  N x / N y = N (divM x y)
  recip (N x) = N (recipM x)
  fromRational = undefined

factV :: U.Vector N
factV = U.scanl' (*) 1 (U.enumFromN 1 (modulo' - 1))

factM :: Int -> N
factM n | n < modulo' = factV U.! n
        | otherwise = 0

invFactM :: Int -> N
invFactM n | n < modulo' = if even n
                           then - factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
                           else factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
           | otherwise = error "invFactM: divide by zero"

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> N
solve x 0 n = (fromIntegral x)^n
solve !x !d !n = let !x' = fromIntegral x :: N
                     !d' = fromIntegral d :: N
                     !xd = fromIntegral $ unwrapN (x' / d') :: Int
                 in if xd + n - 1 >= modulo'
                    then 0
                    else d'^n * factM (xd + fromIntegral n - 1) * invFactM (xd - 1)

readInt3 :: BS.ByteString -> (Int, Int, Int)
readInt3 s =
    let Just (x, s') = BS.readInt s
        Just (d, s'') = BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s'
        Just (n, _) = BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s''
    in (x, d, n)

readInt3' :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe ((Int, Int, Int), BS.ByteString)
readInt3' s = do
    (x, s') <- BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s
    (d, s'') <- BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s'
    (n, rest) <- BS.readInt $ BS.dropWhile isSpace s''
    return ((x, d, n), rest)

main = do
  q <- readLn
  -- input <- U.unfoldrN q readInt3' <$> BS.getContents
  input <- U.replicateM q (readInt3 <$> BS.getLine)
  -- let answer = U.map (\(x,d,n) -> solve x d n) input
  -- U.mapM_ print answer
  BSB.hPutBuilder stdout $ U.foldr (\x b -> (BSB.int32Dec $ unwrapN x) <> BSB.char7 '\n' <> b) mempty $ U.map (\(x,d,n) -> solve x d n) input

{-# INLINE query #-}
query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
query (I# x#) (I# d#) (I# n#) = I# (query# x# d# n#)

{-# INLINE query# #-}
query# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int# -> Int#
query# x# d# n#
  | isTrue# (x# ==# 0#) = 0#
  | isTrue# (n# >=# MOD#) = 0#
  | isTrue# (d# ==# 0#) = x# `powRem#` n#
query# x# d# n#
  | isTrue# (end# >=# MOD#) = 0#
  | otherwise = (unI# $ factorial `VU.unsafeIndex` (I# end#))
                `mult#` (unI# $ invFact `VU.unsafeIndex` (I# begm1#))
                `mult#` (d# `powRem#` n#)
  where
    begm1# = (x# `mult#` invMod# d#) -# 1#
    end# = begm1# +# n#



{-# INLINE CONLIKE unI# #-}
unI# :: Int -> Int#
unI# = \(I# x#) -> x#

-- assumes 0 <= x# < modulus, y# >= 0#.
powRem# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int#
powRem# x# y# = go 1# x# y#
  where
    go acc# val# 0# = acc#
    go acc# val# expt#
      = go (if isTrue# (andI# expt# 1#) then acc# `mult#` val# else acc#)
           (val# `mult#` val#)
           (expt# `uncheckedIShiftRL#` 1#)

{-# NOINLINE factorial #-}
factorial :: VU.Vector Int
factorial = VU.scanl' mult 1 $ VU.tail $ VU.generate modulus id

{-# NOINLINE invFact #-}
invFact :: VU.Vector Int
invFact = VU.map invMod factorial

{-# INLINE mult #-}
mult :: Int -> Int -> Int
mult = \(I# x#) (I# y#) -> I# (mult# x# y#)

{-# INLINE mult# #-}
mult# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int#
mult# = \ x# y# -> (x# *# y#) `remInt#` MOD#

{-# INLINE invMod #-}
invMod :: Int -> Int
invMod = \(I# x#) -> I# (invMod# x#)

{-# INLINE invMod# #-}
-- assumes 0 < x < modulus.
invMod# :: Int# -> Int#
invMod# x# = go 0# MOD# 1# x#
  where
    go a# x# b# 0# = a# +# if isTrue# (a# <# 0#) then MOD# else 0#
    go a# x# b# y# = go b# y# (a# -# q# *# b#) z#
      where (# q#,z# #) = x# `quotRemInt#` y#

solve :: Int -> U.Vector (Int, Int, Int) -> U.Vector Int
solve _ = U.map solve'

solve' :: (Int, Int, Int) -> Int
solve' (x, d, n)
    | d == 0 = x ^% n
    | n >= modulus = 0
    | xd + n - 1 >= modulus = 0
    | otherwise = (d ^% n) *% (fact (xd + n - 1) /% fact (xd - 1))
  where
    !xd = x /% d

infixr 8 ^%

type IntMod = Int

intMod :: Int -> IntMod
intMod x = rem x MOD

intModValidate :: Int -> Bool
intModValidate x = 0 <= x && x < MOD

(+%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) +% (I# y#) = case x# +# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# -# ((r# >=# MOD#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (+%) #-}

(-%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) -% (I# y#) = case x# -# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# +# ((r# <# 0#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (-%) #-}

(*%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod

(/%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) /% (I# y#) = go# y# MOD# 1# 0#
  where
    go# a# b# u# v#
        | isTrue# (b# ># 0#) = case a# `quotInt#` b# of
            q# -> go# b# (a# -# (q# *# b#)) v# (u# -# (q# *# v#))

(^%) :: IntMod -> Int -> IntMod
x ^% n
    | n > 0 = go 1 x n
    | n == 0 = 1
    | otherwise = go 1 (1 /% x) (-n)
  where
    go !acc !y !m
        | m .&. 1 == 0 = go acc (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR m 1)
        | m == 1 = acc *% y
        | otherwise = go (acc *% y) (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR (m - 1) 1)

solve' :: (Int, Int, Int) -> Int
solve' (intMod -> x, intMod -> d, n)
    | n >= modulus = 0
    | d == 0 || xd == 0 = 0
    | xd == 1 = fact n
    | otherwise = (d ^% n) *% (fact (xd + n - 1) /% fact (xd - 1))
  where

exEuclid :: (Eq a, Integral a) => a -> a -> (a, a, a)
exEuclid !f !g = loop 1 0 0 1 f g
  where loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f 0 = (f, u0, v0)
        loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f g =
          case quotRem f g of
            (q,0) -> (g, u1, v1)
            (q,r) -> loop u1 (u0 - q * u1) v1 (v0 - q * v1) g r

modulo = 10^6+3 :: Int32

addMod, subMod, mulMod, divM :: Int32 -> Int32 -> Int32
addMod !x !y = (x + y) `rem` modulo
subMod !x !y = (x - y) `mod` modulo
mulMod !x !y = fromIntegral ((fromIntegral x * fromIntegral y :: Int64) `rem` fromIntegral modulo)
recipM :: Int32 -> Int32
recipM !x = case exEuclid x modulo of
             (1,a,_) -> a `mod` modulo
             (-1,a,_) -> (-a) `mod` modulo
divM !x !y = x `mulMod` recipM y

  show (N x) = show x
instance Num N where
  N x + N y = N ((x + y) `rem` modulo)
  N x - N y = N ((x - y) `mod` modulo)
  N x * N y = N (mulMod x y)
  fromInteger n = N (fromInteger (n `mod` fromIntegral modulo))
  abs = undefined; signum = undefined

instance Fractional N where
  N x / N y = N (divM x y)
  recip (N x) = N (recipM x)
  fromRational = undefined

factM n | n < modulo' = factV U.! n
        | otherwise = 0

invFactM :: Int -> N
invFactM n | n < modulo' = if even n
                           then - factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
                           else factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
           | otherwise = error "invFactM: divide by zero"

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> N
solve x 0 n = (fromIntegral x)^n
solve !x !d !n = let !x' = fromIntegral x :: N
                     !d' = fromIntegral d :: N
                     !xd = fromIntegral $ unwrapN (x' / d') :: Int
                 in if xd + n - 1 >= modulo'
                    then 0
                    else d'^n * factM (xd + fromIntegral n - 1) * invFactM (xd - 1)

query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Rem
query !x !d !n
  | x == 0 = Rem 0

  | end >= modulus = Rem 0

    end = beg + n-1

{-# INLINE extEuc #-}
extEuc :: (Integral a) => a -> a -> (a,a,a)
extEuc x0 y0
  = loop (signum x0) 0 (abs x0) 0 (signum y0) (abs y0)
  where
    loop !a !b !x !c !d 0 = (a,b,x)
    loop !a !b !x !c !d !y
      = loop c d y (a - q*c) (b - q*d) z
      where
        (q,z) = x `quotRem` y

{-# SPECIALIZE invMod :: Int -> Int -> Maybe Int #-}

invMod :: (Integral a) => a -> a -> Maybe a
invMod x m
  | g == 1 = Just r'
  | otherwise = Nothing
  where
    (_,r,g) = extEuc m x
    r' = r `mod` m

newtype Rem = Rem {unRem :: Int} deriving Eq
instance Num Rem where
  Rem x - Rem y = Rem $ x-y + if x >= y then 0 else modulus
  negate (Rem x) = Rem $ modulus - x
  x + y = x - (-y)
  fromInteger x = Rem $ fromInteger (x `mod` toInteger modulus)
  Rem x * Rem y = Rem ((x * y) `rem` modulus)
  abs = id
  signum (Rem 0) = Rem 0
  signum _ = Rem 1
instance Fractional Rem where
  recip (Rem x) = Rem $ fromJust $ invMod x modulus
  fromRational p = fromInteger (numerator p) / fromInteger (denominator p)

type IntMod = Int

intMod :: Int -> IntMod
intMod x = mod x MOD

intModValidate :: Int -> Bool
intModValidate x = 0 <= x && x < MOD

(+%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) +% (I# y#) = case x# +# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# -# ((r# >=# MOD#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (+%) #-}

(-%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) -% (I# y#) = case x# -# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# +# ((r# <# 0#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (-%) #-}

(*%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) *% (I# y#) = I# ((x# *# y#) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (*%) #-}

(/%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) /% (I# y#) = go# y# MOD# 1# 0#
  where
    go# a# b# u# v#
        | isTrue# (b# ># 0#) = case a# `quotInt#` b# of
            q# -> go# b# (a# -# (q# *# b#)) v# (u# -# (q# *# v#))
        | otherwise = I# ((x# *# (u# +# MOD#)) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (/%) #-}

(^%) :: IntMod -> Int -> IntMod
x ^% n
    | n > 0 = go 1 x n
    | n == 0 = 1
    | otherwise = go 1 (1 /% x) (-n)
  where
    go !acc !y !m
        | m .&. 1 == 0 = go acc (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR m 1)
        | m == 1 = acc *% y
        | otherwise = go (acc *% y) (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR (m - 1) 1)

exEuclid :: (Eq a, Integral a) => a -> a -> (a, a, a)
exEuclid !f !g = loop 1 0 0 1 f g
  where loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f 0 = (f, u0, v0)
        loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f g =
          case divMod f g of
            (q,r) -> loop u1 (u0 - q * u1) v1 (v0 - q * v1) g r

modulo = 10^6+3 :: Int64
addMod, subMod, mulMod, divM :: Int64 -> Int64 -> Int64
addMod !x !y = (x + y) `rem` modulo
subMod !x !y = (x - y) `mod` modulo
mulMod !x !y = (x * y) `rem` modulo
recipM :: Int64 -> Int64
recipM !x = case exEuclid x modulo of
             (1,a,_) -> a `mod` modulo
             (-1,a,_) -> (-a) `mod` modulo
divM !x !y = x `mulMod` recipM y

newtype N = N { unwrapN :: Int64 } deriving (Eq)
instance Show N where
  show (N x) = show x
instance Num N where
  N x + N y = N ((x + y) `rem` modulo)
  N x - N y = N ((x - y) `mod` modulo)
  N x * N y = N ((x * y) `rem` modulo)
  fromInteger n = N (fromInteger (n `mod` fromIntegral modulo))
  abs = undefined; signum = undefined

instance Fractional N where
  N x / N y = N (divM x y)
  recip (N x) = N (recipM x)
  fromRational = undefined

factL :: [N]
factL = 1 : zipWith (*) factL (map fromInteger [1..])

factFromN :: Int -> Int -> N -> V.Vector N
factFromN n m factN = V.scanl' (\a b -> a * fromIntegral b) factN (V.enumFromN (n+1) (m-1))

factV :: V.Vector N
factV = V.scanl' (\a b -> a * fromIntegral b) 1 (V.enumFromN 1 (fromIntegral modulo - 1))

-- factM n == factL !! n == product (map fromInteger [1..n])
-- factM 150000 == 835006
-- factM 300000 == 142803
-- factM 600000 == 715492
-- factM 800000 == 598805
factM :: Int64 -> N
factM n | n < modulo = factV V.! fromIntegral n
        | otherwise = 0

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> N
solve x 0 n = (fromIntegral x)^n
solve !x !d !n = let !x' = fromIntegral x :: N
                     !d' = fromIntegral d :: N
                     !xd = unwrapN (x' / d')
                 in if xd + fromIntegral n - 1 >= modulo
                    then 0
                    else d'^n * factM (xd + fromIntegral n - 1) / factM (xd - 1)

query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Rem
query !x !d !n
  | x == 0 = Rem 0
  | d == 0 = Rem x ^ n
  | end >= modulus = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem (factorial VU.! end)
                * Rem (invFact VU.! (beg-1))
                * Rem d ^ n
  where
    xdivd = Rem x / Rem d
    beg = unRem xdivd
    end = beg + n

factorial :: VU.Vector Int

invFact :: VU.Vector Int

extEuc :: (Integral a) => a -> a -> (a,a,a)
extEuc x0 y0
  = loop (signum x0) 0 (abs x0) 0 (signum y0) (abs y0)
  where
    loop !a !b !x !c !d 0 = (a,b,x)
    loop !a !b !x !c !d !y
      = loop c d y (a - q*c) (b - q*d) z
      where
        (q,z) = x `quotRem` y

{-# SPECIALIZE invMod :: Int -> Int -> Maybe Int #-}

invMod :: (Integral a) => a -> a -> Maybe a
invMod x m
  | g == 1 = Just r'
  | otherwise = Nothing
  where
    (_,r,g) = extEuc m x
    r' = r `mod` m

newtype Rem = Rem {unRem :: Int} deriving Eq
instance Num Rem where
  Rem x - Rem y = Rem $ x-y + if x >= y then 0 else modulus

  x + y = x - (-y)
  fromInteger x = Rem $ fromInteger (x `mod` toInteger modulus)
  Rem x * Rem y = Rem (x * y `rem` modulus)
  abs = id
  signum (Rem 0) = Rem 0
  signum _ = Rem 1
instance Fractional Rem where
  recip (Rem x) = Rem $ fromJust $ invMod x modulus
  fromRational p = fromInteger (numerator p) / fromInteger (denominator p)

exEuclid :: (Eq a, Integral a) => a -> a -> (a, a, a)
exEuclid !f !g = loop 1 0 0 1 f g
  where loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f 0 = (f, u0, v0)
        loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f g =
          case quotRem f g of
            (q,0) -> (g, u1, v1)
            (q,r) -> loop u1 (u0 - q * u1) v1 (v0 - q * v1) g r

addMod, subMod, mulMod, divM :: Int32 -> Int32 -> Int32
addMod !x !y = (x + y) `rem` modulo
subMod !x !y = (x - y) `mod` modulo
mulMod !x !y = fromIntegral ((fromIntegral x * fromIntegral y :: Int64) `rem` fromIntegral modulo)
recipM :: Int32 -> Int32
recipM !x = case exEuclid x modulo of
             (1,a,_) -> a `mod` modulo
             (-1,a,_) -> (-a) `mod` modulo
divM !x !y = case exEuclid y modulo of
               (1,!a,_) -> fromIntegral ((fromIntegral x * fromIntegral a :: Int64) `mod` fromIntegral modulo)
               (-1,!a,_) -> fromIntegral ((- fromIntegral x * fromIntegral a :: Int64) `mod` fromIntegral modulo)

invFactM :: Int -> N

                           then - factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
                           else factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
           | otherwise = error "invFactM: divide by zero"

query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Rem
query !x !d !n

  | end >= modulus = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem (factorial VU.! end)

  = loop (signum x0) 0 (abs x0) 0 (signum y0) (abs y0)
  where
    loop !a !b !x !c !d 0 = (a,b,x)
    loop !a !b !x !c !d !y

      where

invMod x m

    r' = r `mod` m

  negate (Rem x) = Rem $ modulus - x

{-# INLINE query #-}
query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
query (I# x#) (I# d#) (I# n#) = I# (query# x# d# n#)


query# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int# -> Int#
query# x# d# n#
  | isTrue# (x# ==# 0#) = 0#
  | isTrue# (d# ==# 0#) = x# `powRem#` (n# `remInt#` (MOD# -# 1#))
  | isTrue# (n# >=# MOD#) = 0#                                                               
query# x# d# n#
  | isTrue# (end# >=# MOD#) = 0#
  | otherwise = (unI# $ factorial `VU.unsafeIndex` (I# end#))
                `mult#` (invMod# (unI# $ factorial `VU.unsafeIndex` (I# begm1#)))
                `mult#` (d# `powRem#` n#)
  where
    begm1# = (x# `mult#` invMod# d#) -# 1#
    end# = begm1# +# n#

unI# = \(I# x#) -> x#

-- assumes 0 <= x# < modulus, y# >= 0#.
{-# INLINE powRem# #-}
powRem# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int#
powRem# x# y# = go 1# x# y#
  where
    go acc# val# 0# = acc#
    go acc# val# expt#
      = go (if isTrue# (andI# expt# 1#) then acc# `mult#` val# else acc#)
           (val# `mult#` val#)
           (expt# `uncheckedIShiftRL#` 1#)

  where

    go a# x# b# y# = go b# y# (a# -# q# *# b#) z#

exEuclid :: (Eq a, Integral a) => a -> a -> (a, a, a)
exEuclid !f !g = loop 1 0 0 1 f g
  where loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f 0 = (f, u0, v0)
        loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f g =
          case quotRem f g of
            (q,0) -> (g, u1, v1)
            (q,r) -> loop u1 (u0 - q * u1) v1 (v0 - q * v1) g r

modulo = 10^6+3 :: Int32
modulo' = fromIntegral modulo :: Int
addMod, subMod, mulMod, divM :: Int32 -> Int32 -> Int32
addMod !x !y = (x + y) `rem` modulo
subMod !x !y = (x - y) `mod` modulo
mulMod !x !y = fromIntegral ((fromIntegral x * fromIntegral y :: Int64) `rem` fromIntegral modulo)
recipM :: Int32 -> Int32
recipM !x = case exEuclid x modulo of
             (1,a,_) -> a `mod` modulo
             (-1,a,_) -> (-a) `mod` modulo
divM !x !y = x `mulMod` recipM y

newtype N = N { unwrapN :: Int32 } deriving (Eq)
instance Show N where
  show (N x) = show x
instance Num N where
  N x + N y = N ((x + y) `rem` modulo)
  N x - N y = N ((x - y) `mod` modulo)
  N x * N y = N (mulMod x y)
  fromInteger n = N (fromInteger (n `mod` fromIntegral modulo))
  abs = undefined; signum = undefined

instance Fractional N where
  N x / N y = N (divM x y)
  recip (N x) = N (recipM x)
  fromRational = undefined

factV :: U.Vector N
factV = U.scanl' (*) 1 (U.enumFromN 1 (modulo' - 1))

factM :: Int -> N
factM n | n < modulo' = factV U.! n
        | otherwise = 0

invFactM :: Int -> N
invFactM n | n < modulo' = if even n
                           then - factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
                           else factV U.! (modulo' - n - 1)
           | otherwise = error "invFactM: divide by zero"

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> N
solve x 0 n = (fromIntegral x)^n
solve !x !d !n = let !x' = fromIntegral x :: N
                     !d' = fromIntegral d :: N
                     !xd = fromIntegral $ unwrapN (x' / d') :: Int
                 in if xd + n - 1 >= modulo'
                    then 0
                    else d'^(n `rem` (modulo' - 1)) * factM (xd + fromIntegral n - 1) * invFactM (xd - 1)

solve' :: (Int, Int, Int) -> Int
solve' (x, d, n)
    | d == 0 = x ^% n
    | n >= modulus = 0
    | otherwise = (d ^% n) *% (fact (xd + n - 1) /% fact (xd - 1))
  where
    !xd = x /% d

type IntMod = Int

intMod :: Int -> IntMod
intMod x = rem x MOD

intModValidate :: Int -> Bool
intModValidate x = 0 <= x && x < MOD

(+%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) +% (I# y#) = case x# +# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# -# ((r# >=# MOD#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (+%) #-}

(-%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) -% (I# y#) = case x# -# y# of
    r# -> I# (r# +# ((r# <# 0#) *# MOD#))
{-# INLINE (-%) #-}

(*%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) *% (I# y#) = I# ((x# *# y#) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (*%) #-}

(/%) :: IntMod -> IntMod -> IntMod
(I# x#) /% (I# y#) = go# y# MOD# 1# 0#
  where
    go# a# b# u# v#
        | isTrue# (b# ># 0#) = case a# `quotInt#` b# of
            q# -> go# b# (a# -# (q# *# b#)) v# (u# -# (q# *# v#))
        | otherwise = I# ((x# *# (u# +# MOD#)) `remInt#` MOD#)
{-# INLINE (/%) #-}

(^%) :: IntMod -> Int -> IntMod
x ^% n
    | n > 0 = go 1 x n
    | n == 0 = 1
    | otherwise = go 1 (1 /% x) (-n)
  where
    go !acc !y !m
        | m .&. 1 == 0 = go acc (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR m 1)
        | m == 1 = acc *% y
        | otherwise = go (acc *% y) (y *% y) (unsafeShiftR (m - 1) 1)

recipFact :: Int -> IntMod

comb :: Int -> Int -> IntMod
comb n k = fact n *% recipFact (n - k) *% recipFact k

factCache :: U.Vector IntMod

{-# INLINE query #-}
query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Int
query (I# x#) (I# d#) (I# n#) = I# (query# x# d# n#)

{-# INLINE query# #-}
query# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int# -> Int#
query# x# d# n#
  | isTrue# (x# ==# 0#) = 0#
  | isTrue# (d# ==# 0#) = x# `powRem#` n#
query# x# d# n#
  | isTrue# (end# >=# MOD#) = 0#
  | otherwise = (unI# $ factorial `VU.unsafeIndex` (I# end#))
                `mult#` (unI# $ invFact `VU.unsafeIndex` (I# begm1#))
                `mult#` (d# `powRem#` n#)
  where
    begm1# = (x# `mult#` invMod# d#) -# 1#
    end# = begm1# +# n#



{-# INLINE CONLIKE unI# #-}
unI# :: Int -> Int#
unI# = \(I# x#) -> x#

-- assumes 0 <= x# < modulus, y# >= 0#.
powRem# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int#
powRem# x# y# = go 1# x# y#
  where
    go acc# val# 0# = acc#
    go acc# val# expt#
      = go (if isTrue# (andI# expt# 1#) then acc# `mult#` val# else acc#)
           (val# `mult#` val#)
           (expt# `uncheckedIShiftRL#` 1#)

{-# NOINLINE factorial #-}
factorial :: VU.Vector Int
factorial = VU.scanl' mult 1 $ VU.tail $ VU.generate modulus id

{-# NOINLINE invFact #-}
invFact :: VU.Vector Int
invFact = VU.map invMod factorial

{-# INLINE mult #-}
mult :: Int -> Int -> Int
mult = \(I# x#) (I# y#) -> I# (mult# x# y#)

{-# INLINE mult# #-}
mult# :: Int# -> Int# -> Int#
mult# = \ x# y# -> (x# *# y#) `remInt#` MOD#

{-# INLINE invMod #-}
invMod :: Int -> Int
invMod = \(I# x#) -> I# (invMod# x#)

{-# INLINE invMod# #-}
-- assumes 0 < x < modulus.
invMod# :: Int# -> Int#
invMod# x# = go 0# MOD# 1# x#
  where
    go a# x# b# 0# = a# +# if isTrue# (a# <# 0#) then MOD# else 0#
    go a# x# b# y# = go b# y# (a# -# q# *# b#) z#
      where (# q#,z# #) = x# `quotRemInt#` y#

exEuclid :: (Eq a, Integral a) => a -> a -> (a, a, a)
exEuclid !f !g = loop 1 0 0 1 f g
  where loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f 0 = (f, u0, v0)
        loop !u0 !u1 !v0 !v1 !f g =
          case divMod f g of
            (q,r) -> loop u1 (u0 - q * u1) v1 (v0 - q * v1) g r

modulo = 10^6+3 :: Int32
addMod, subMod, mulMod, divM :: Int32 -> Int32 -> Int32
addMod !x !y = (x + y) `rem` modulo
subMod !x !y = (x - y) `mod` modulo
mulMod !x !y = fromIntegral ((fromIntegral x * fromIntegral y :: Int64) `rem` fromIntegral modulo)
recipM :: Int32 -> Int32
recipM !x = case exEuclid x modulo of
             (1,a,_) -> a `mod` modulo
             (-1,a,_) -> (-a) `mod` modulo
divM !x !y = x `mulMod` recipM y

newtype N = N { unwrapN :: Int32 } deriving (Eq)
instance Show N where
  show (N x) = show x
instance Num N where
  N x + N y = N ((x + y) `rem` modulo)
  N x - N y = N ((x - y) `mod` modulo)
  N x * N y = N (mulMod x y)
  fromInteger n = N (fromInteger (n `mod` fromIntegral modulo))
  abs = undefined; signum = undefined

instance Fractional N where
  N x / N y = N (divM x y)
  recip (N x) = N (recipM x)
  fromRational = undefined

factV :: U.Vector N
factV = U.scanl' (*) 1 (U.enumFromN 1 (fromIntegral modulo - 1))

factM :: Int -> N
factM n | n < fromIntegral modulo = factV U.! n
        | otherwise = 0

invFactM :: Int -> N
invFactM n | n < fromIntegral modulo = if even n
                                       then - factV U.! (fromIntegral modulo - n - 1)
                                       else factV U.! (fromIntegral modulo - n - 1)
           | otherwise = error "invFactM: divide by zero"

solve :: Int -> Int -> Int -> N
solve x 0 n = (fromIntegral x)^n
solve !x !d !n = let !x' = fromIntegral x :: N
                     !d' = fromIntegral d :: N
                     !xd = fromIntegral $ unwrapN (x' / d') :: Int
                 in if xd + n - 1 >= fromIntegral modulo
                    then 0
                    else d'^n * factM (xd + fromIntegral n - 1) * invFactM (xd - 1)

query :: Int -> Int -> Int -> Rem
query !x !d !n
  | x == 0 = Rem 0
  | d == 0 = Rem x ^ n
  | end >= modulus = Rem 0
  | otherwise = Rem (factorial VU.! end)
                * Rem (invFact VU.! (beg-1))
                * Rem d ^ n
  where
    xdivd = Rem x / Rem d
    beg = unRem xdivd
    end = beg + n-1

{-# INLINE extEuc #-}
extEuc :: Int -> Int -> (Int,Int,Int)
extEuc x0 y0
  = loop (signum x0) 0 (abs x0) 0 (signum y0) (abs y0)
  where
    loop !a !b !x !c !d 0 = (a,b,x)
    loop !a !b !x !c !d !y
      = loop c d y (a - q*c) (b - q*d) z
      where
        (q,z) = x `quotRem` y

{-# INLINE invMod #-}
invMod :: Int -> Int -> Maybe Int
invMod x m
  | g == 1 = Just r'
  | otherwise = Nothing
  where
    (_,r,g) = extEuc m x
    r' = r `mod` m

newtype Rem = Rem {unRem :: Int} deriving Eq
instance Num Rem where
  {-# INLINE (-) #-}
  Rem x - Rem y = Rem $ x-y + if x >= y then 0 else modulus
  {-# INLINE negate #-}
  negate (Rem x) = Rem $ modulus - x
  {-# INLINE (+) #-}
  x + y = x - (-y)
  fromInteger x = Rem $ fromInteger (x `mod` toInteger modulus)
  {-# INLINE (*) #-}
  Rem x * Rem y = Rem ((x * y) `rem` modulus)
  abs = id
  signum (Rem 0) = Rem 0
  signum _ = Rem 1
instance Fractional Rem where
  {-# INLINE recip #-}
  recip = \(Rem x) -> Rem $ fromJust $ invMod x modulus
  fromRational p = fromInteger (numerator p) / fromInteger (denominator p)

def powmod(b,r,mod)
  a = 1
  while r > 0
    if r%2 == 1
      a = a * b % mod
    end
    b = b * b % mod
    r /= 2
  end
  a
end

  powmod(f, mod-2, mod)
end

# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # #
from sequtils import map, mapIt, toSeq
from strutils import split, parseInt, parseFloat, parseBool, parseEnum
when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor >= 14: from strutils import parseUint

import macros
# headaux macro -- https://stackoverflow.com/questions/31948131/unpack-multiple-variables-from-sequence
# unpack (toTuple) macro  -- https://chy72.hatenablog.com/entry/2017/12/16/214708
macro unpack*(input: array|seq|tuple; count: static[int]): untyped =
  var t = genSym()
  result = quote do: (let `t` = `input`; ())
  when NimMajor == 0 and NimMinor <= 17:
    for i in 0..<count: result[0][1].add quote do: `t`[`i`]
  else:
    for i in 0..<count: result[1].add quote do: `t`[`i`]

template input*(typ: static[typedesc]): seq =
  when typ is char:
    toSeq(stdin.readLine.items)
  elif typ is string:
    stdin.readLine.split
  else:
    stdin.readLine.split.map(`parse typ`)

# 2引数の input() は通常こちらが呼ばれる
template input*(typ: static[typedesc]; count: static[int]): untyped =
  input(typ).unpack(count)

# input(typ, [some integer].Positive) と指定しないとこちらは呼ばれない
template input*(typ: static[typedesc]; lineCount: Positive): untyped =
  (1..lineCount).mapIt(input(typ))

template input*(typ: static[typedesc]; count: static[int] = 1; lineCount: Positive): untyped =
  (1..lineCount).mapIt(input(typ, count))

macro inputs*(body: untyped): untyped =
  result = newNimNode(nnkStmtList)

  var letSection = newNimNode(nnkLetSection)

  var vars = newSeq[NimNode](body.len)
  for i, _ in vars:
    if body[i][0].len > 1: # (var1, var2, ...): int | float | string
      vars[i] = newNimNode(nnkVarTuple)
      for ident in body[i][0]:
        vars[i].add(ident)
      vars[i].add(newEmptyNode())
      vars[i].add(newNimNode(nnkCall)
                    .add(ident("input"))
                    .add(body[i][1][0])
                    .add(newLit(body[i][0].len))
                 )
    elif body[i][1][0].len == 0: # variable: int | float | string
      vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
        body[i][0],
        newEmptyNode(),
        newNimNode(nnkCall)
          .add(ident("input"))
          .add(body[i][1][0])
          .add(newLit(1))
      )
    elif body[i][1][0][0].len > 0: # variable: tuple[field1, field2, ...: T]
      var tupleIdents = newNimNode(nnkIdentDefs)
      for ident in body[i][1][0][0]:
        tupleIdents.add(ident)
      let tuplety = newNimNode(nnkTupleTy).add(tupleIdents)

      vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
        body[i][0],
        tuplety,
        newNimNode(nnkCall)
          .add(ident("input"))
          .add(body[i][1][0][0][^2])
          .add(newLit(body[i][1][0][0].len - 2))
      )
    elif body[i][1][0][0].len == 0: # seq
      if body[i][1][0].len == 2: # variable: seq[int | float | string | char]
        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newEmptyNode(),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][1])
        )
      elif body[i][1][0].len == 3 and body[i][1][0][2].len == 0: # variable: seq[N, int | float | string | char]
        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newEmptyNode(),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][2])
            .add(newLit(1))
            .add(body[i][1][0][1])
        )
      elif body[i][1][0][2].len == 2: # variable: seq[lineCount, seq[int | float | string | char]]
        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newEmptyNode(),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][2][1])
            .add(newNimNode(nnkDotExpr)
              .add(body[i][1][0][1])
              .add(ident("Positive"))
            )
        )
      else: # variable: seq[lineCount, tuple[field1, field2, ...: T]]
        var tupleIdents = newNimNode(nnkIdentDefs)
        for ident in body[i][1][0][2][0]:
          tupleIdents.add(ident)
        let tuplety = newNimNode(nnkTupleTy).add(tupleIdents)

        vars[i] = newIdentDefs(
          body[i][0],
          newNimNode(nnkBracketExpr).add(body[i][1][0][0]).add(tuplety),
          newNimNode(nnkCall)
            .add(ident("input"))
            .add(body[i][1][0][2][0][^2])
            .add(newLit(body[i][1][0][2][0].len - 2))
            .add(body[i][1][0][1])
        )
    else:
      discard

  for `var` in vars:
    letSection.add(`var`)

  result.add(letSection)

proc `//=`*(x: var SomeInteger; y: SomeInteger) = x = x div y
proc `%=`*(x: var SomeInteger; y: SomeInteger) = x = x mod y
proc `<?=`*[T](x: var T; y: T) = x = min(x, y)
proc `>?=`*[T](x: var T; y: T) = x = max(x, y)

from sequtils import concat

template flatten*[T](s: seq[T]): untyped =
  when T is seq: flatten(s.concat)
  else: s
proc flatten*[T](s: seq[T]; recLevel: static[Natural]): auto =
  when recLevel == 0: s
  elif T is seq: flatten(s.concat, recLevel - 1)
  else: s

# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # #
proc indexed*[T](s: openArray[T]): seq[tuple[i: int, v: T]] =
  (0..s.high).mapIt((it, s[it]))

# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # #
template countIt*[T](a: openArray[T]; pred: untyped): int =
  var result = 0
  for it {.inject.} in items(a):
    if pred: result.inc
  result

# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # #
template stderrEcho*(x: varargs[string, `$`]) =
  for v in x:
    stderr.write(v)
  stderr.writeLine ""

template stderrEcho*[T](x: seq[seq[T]]) =
  for v in x: stderrEcho v

template stderrEcho*(x: seq[string]) =
  for v in x: stderrEcho v

# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # #
proc modPow(n, p: int, m = 1_000_000_007): int =
  if p == 0:
    1
  elif p mod 2 == 0:
    let half = modPow(n, p div 2, m)
    half * half mod m
  else:
    n * modPow(n, p - 1, m) mod m

proc modInv(n: int, MOD = 1_000_000_007): int =
  modPow(n, MOD - 2, MOD)

# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # #
const
  MOD = 1_000_003 # これは素数
  tableLen = 2 * MOD

proc sub(x, y: int): int = x - y

proc `+`(x, y: int): int = system.`+`(x, y) mod MOD
proc `-`(x, y: int): int = system.`-`(x, y) mod MOD + MOD
proc `*`(x, y: int): int = system.`*`(x, y) mod MOD + MOD
proc `div`(x, y: int): int = x * modInv(y, MOD)
proc `^`(x, y: int): int = modPow(x, y, MOD)

proc createFactorialTable(): array[-1..(tableLen - 1), int] =
  result[-1] = 1
  result[0] = 1
  for i in 1..(result.len - 2):
    result[i] = result[i - 1] * i

inputs:
  Q: int
  queries: seq[Q, tuple[x, d, n: int]]

let facs = createFactorialTable()

for query in queries:
  if query.n >= MOD:
    echo 0
  elif query.d == 0:
    echo query.x ^ query.n
  else:
    let
      y = query.x div query.d
      z = sub(y, 1)
    echo facs[z + query.n] div facs[z] * query.d ^ query.n

    # faster than the following code

    #     return factorial(n) // (factorial(n - r) * factorial(r))
    if n - r < r: r = n - r

def gcd(a, b):
    def calc(a, b, first, second):
        if a < b:
            a, b = b, a
        r = a % b
        q = -(a - r)//b
        if r == 0:
            return b, second
        # first += q * second
        first = [x + q * y for (x, y) in zip(first, second)]
        return calc(r, b, second, first)
    first = [1, 0]
    second = [0, 1]
    return calc(a, b, first, second)

    table = gcd(n, mod)
    inv = table[1][1]
    if inv < 0:
        inv += mod
    return inv

    ret = 1
    while n > 0:
        if n & 1 != 0:
            ret *= x
            ret %= mod
        x *= x
        x %= mod
        n >>= 1
    return ret

def get_factorials(max, mod=None):
    """
    階乗 0!, 1!, 2!, ..., max!
    :param int max:
    :param int mod:
    """
    ret = [1]
    n = 1
    if mod:
        for i in range(1, max + 1):
            n *= i
            n %= mod
            ret.append(n)
    else:
        for i in range(1, max + 1):
            n *= i
            ret.append(n)
    return ret


def mod_invs(max, mod):
    """
    逆元 0, 1/1, 1/2, 1/3, ..., 1/max
    :param int max:
    :param int mod:
    """
    invs = [1] * (max + 1)
    invs[0] = 0
    for x in range(2, max + 1):
        invs[x] = (-(mod // x) * invs[mod % x]) % mod
    return invs


def factorial_invs(max, mod):
    """
    階乗 0!, 1!, 2!, ..., max! の逆元
    :param int max:
    :param int mod:
    """
    ret = [1]
    r = 1
    for inv in mod_invs(max, mod)[1:]:
        r = r * inv % mod
        ret.append(r)
    return ret


factorials = get_factorials(MOD, MOD)

    if num >= MOD:

def combinations_count(n, r):
    # faster than the following code
    # def combinations_count(n, r):
    #     return factorial(n) // (factorial(n - r) * factorial(r))
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p-1,r,p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot
    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])
    return result

    def calc(a, b, first, second):
        if a < b:
            a, b = b, a
        r = a % b
        q = -(a - r)/b
        if r == 0:
            return b, second
        # first += q * second
        first = [x + q * y for (x, y) in zip(first, second)]
        return calc(r, b, second, first)
    first = [1, 0]
    second = [0, 1]
    return calc(a, b, first, second)

def extgcd(a, b):
    r = [1, 0, a]
    w = [0, 1, b]
    while w[2] != 1:
        q = r[2] // w[2]
        r2 = w
        w2 = [r[0] - q * w[0], r[1] - q * w[1], r[2] - q * w[2]]
        r = r2
        w = w2
    #[x,y]
    return [w[0], w[1]]

    x = extgcd(a, m)[0]
    return (m + x % m) % m

#互いに素なa,bについて、a*x+b*y=1の一つの解
def extgcd(a, b):
    r = [1, 0, a]
    w = [0, 1, b]
    while w[2] != 1:
        q = r[2] // w[2]
        r2 = w
        w2 = [r[0] - q * w[0], r[1] - q * w[1], r[2] - q * w[2]]
        r = r2
        w = w2
    #[x,y]
    return [w[0], w[1]]


# aの逆元(mod m)を求める。(aとmは互いに素であることが前提)
def mod_inv(a, m):
    x = extgcd(a, m)[0]
    return (m + x % m) % m

    self.f = [1]

    self.i = [pow(self.f[-1], mod - 2, mod)]

        self.fact = [1]
        for i in range(1, n + 1):

        self.inv_fact = [0] * (n + 1)

def combinations_count(n, r):
    # faster than the following code
    # def combinations_count(n, r):
    #     return factorial(n) // (factorial(n - r) * factorial(r))
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p-1,r,p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot
    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])
    return result
def combination_with_repetition_count(n, r):
    return combinations_count(n + r - 1, r)

class FactMod:

    def __init__(self, n, mod):
        self.mod = mod
        self.f = [1] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            self.f[i] = self.f[i - 1] * i % mod

        self.inv = [pow(self.f[-1], mod - 2, mod)]
        for i in reversed(range(1, n + 1)):
            self.inv.append(self.inv[-1] * i % mod)
        self.inv.reverse()

    def fact(self, n):
        """
        :return: n!
        """
        return self.f[n]

    def comb(self, n, r):
        """
        :return: nCr
        """
        return self.f[n] * self.inv[n - r] * self.inv[r] % self.mod

def gcd(a, b):
    def calc(a, b, first, second):
        if a < b:
            a, b = b, a
        r = a % b
        q = -(a - r)/b
        if r == 0:
            return b, second
        # first += q * second
        first = [x + q * y for (x, y) in zip(first, second)]
        return calc(r, b, second, first)
    first = [1, 0]
    second = [0, 1]
    return calc(a, b, first, second)

def inverse(n, mod):
    table = gcd(n, mod)
    inv = table[1][1]
    if inv < 0:
        inv += mod
    return inv

    ret = 1
    while n > 0:
        if n & 1 != 0:
            ret *= x
            ret %= mod
        x *= x
        x %= mod
        n >>= 1
    return ret

def combinations_count(n, r):
    # faster than the following code
    # def combinations_count(n, r):
    #     return factorial(n) // (factorial(n - r) * factorial(r))
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p-1,r,p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot
    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])
    return result

    return modpow(a, p-2, p)

def modfac(n, MOD):
 
    f = 1
    factorials = [1]
    for m in range(1, n + 1):
        f *= m
        f %= MOD
        factorials.append(f)
    inv = pow(f, MOD - 2, MOD)
    invs = [1] * (n + 1)
    invs[n] = inv
    for m in range(n, 1, -1):
        inv *= m
        inv %= MOD
        invs[m - 1] = inv
    return factorials, invs

def gcd(a, b):
    def calc(a, b, first, second):
        if a < b:
            a, b = b, a
        r = a % b
        q = -(a - r)/b
        if r == 0:
            return b, second
        # first += q * second
        first = [x + q * y for (x, y) in zip(first, second)]
        return calc(r, b, second, first)
    first = [1, 0]
    second = [0, 1]
    return calc(a, b, first, second)

def inverse(n, mod):
    table = gcd(n, mod)
    inv = table[1][1]
    if inv < 0:
        inv += mod
    return inv

def mod_pow(x, n, mod):
    ret = 1
    while n > 0:
        if n & 1 != 0:
            ret *= x
        x *= x
        n >>= 1
    return ret

class Combination:
    '''
    計算量：階乗・逆元テーブルの作成O(N)
            nCkを求めるO(1)
    '''

    def __init__(self, n, MOD):
        self.fact = [1]
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            self.fact.append(self.fact[-1] * i % MOD)
        self.inv_fact = [pow(self.fact[i] ,MOD - 2 ,MOD) for i in range(n + 1)]
        self.MOD = MOD

    def factorial(self, k):
        '''k!を求める'''
        return self.fact[k]

    def inverse_factorial(self, k):
        '''k!の逆元を求める'''
        return self.inv_fact[k]

    def combination(self, k, r):
        '''kCrを求める'''
        return (self.fact[k] * self.inv_fact[k - r] * self.inv_fact[r]) % self.MOD

def combinations_count(n, r):
    # faster than the following code
    # def combinations_count(n, r):
    #     return factorial(n) // (factorial(n - r) * factorial(r))
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):
        pivot = denominator[p - 1]
        if pivot > 1:
            offset = (n - r) % p
            for k in range(p-1,r,p):
                numerator[k - offset] /= pivot
                denominator[k] /= pivot
    result = 1
    for k in range(r):
        if numerator[k] > 1:
            result *= int(numerator[k])
    return result
def combination_with_repetition_count(n, r):
    return combinations_count(n + r - 1, r)

    # faster than the following code
    # def combinations_count(n, r):
    #     return factorial(n) // (factorial(n - r) * factorial(r))
    if n - r < r: r = n - r
    if r == 0: return 1
    if r == 1: return n
    numerator = [n - r + k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    denominator = [k + 1 for k in range(r)]
    for p in range(2,r+1):

def modfac(n, MOD):
 
    f = 1
    factorials = [1]
    for m in range(1, n + 1):
        f *= m
        f %= MOD
        factorials.append(f)
    inv = pow(f, MOD - 2, MOD)
    invs = [1] * (n + 1)
    invs[n] = inv
    for m in range(n, 1, -1):
        inv *= m
        inv %= MOD
        invs[m - 1] = inv
    return factorials, invs

class FactMod:

    def __init__(self, n, mod):
        self.mod = mod
        self.f = [1] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            self.f[i] = self.f[i - 1] * i % mod

        self.inv = [pow(self.f[-1], mod - 2, mod)]
        for i in reversed(range(1, n + 1)):
            self.inv.append(self.inv[-1] * i % mod)
        self.inv.reverse()

    def fact(self, n):
        """
        :return: n!
        """
        return self.f[n]
